systems.use_case: Recommend whether a customer receives a requested credit-limit increase; a credit underwriter remains the decision maker.

human_oversight.intervention_path: The underwriter must accept or reject the recommendation before the limit changes and may override it with a reason code.
human_oversight.alternative_arrangement: A customer may request manual affordability assessment with no model recommendation shown to the decision maker.
human_oversight.customer_review_path: The decision screen and letter link to the human-review request; branch and telephone agents can open the same case.
human_oversight.overrides_recorded_in: The model-oversight ledger, reviewed with outcome and disparity monitoring.

disclosure.english_surface: Credit-limit decision screen and decision letter, English variant.
disclosure.arabic_surface: Credit-limit decision screen and decision letter, Arabic variant.

metrics: underwriter override rate with reason code

_notice: WORKED EXAMPLE ONLY. The bundle did not run the model, observe an intervention or speak to a customer.
